headline: Medical Secretary
summary: Medical secretary with three years supporting doctors at a multi-specialty clinic in Occidental Mindoro and, remotely, a US practice. I manage doctors' calendars and emails, schedule and coordinate patients, prepare medical billing and claims, and keep clinical notes and forms in order. I know medical terms well enough to catch errors before they cause problems.
skills: Virtual assistance for a US practice

experience.title: Medical Secretary
bullets: Manage the calendars and email of four specialists and schedule about 90 patients a day.
Prepare billing, HMO letters of authorisation and PhilHealth claims.
Type and file consultation notes, referral letters and medical certificates.

experience.title: Medical Virtual Assistant
bullets: Confirm and reschedule appointments for a family practice by email and phone.
Verify patient insurance and prepare billing summaries for the practice's biller.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Office Administration
